Twilight Ascension is the pre‑ launch event, introduced in patch 12.0.0 and running from 27 January to 2 March 2026. Centered in the Twilight Highlands, the event features new world quests, rare enemies, and activities focused on disrupting the Twilight's Blade cult. Players can participate in rotating objectives, earn event‑specific rewards, and prepare for the storyline leading into Midnight. The event is available to level 10-80 characters.

Twilight's Blade Insignias drops from rares, weekly quests, world quests during the Twilight Ascension pre-patch event. Each rare drops 2-3 (no daily limits), world quests reward 10, and the weekly quests reward 40 currency. It is used to purchase vanity and gear from Materialist Ophinell and Armorer Kalinovan, found at the event's basecamp.

Two Ranks Higher is the second in a series of Liberation of Undermine achievements involving hard mode on the One-Armed Bandit boss. There are four colored chips found inside the Gallagio while on the way to the One-Armed Bandit. After collecting one (or more) coins, take them to the slot machines in the room immediately before the boss arena and interact with the same-colored machine to deposit the coin and alter the encounter. In order of increasing difficulty, activate red, gold, blue, then purple chips in that order.

The Uktulut Backwater is the home of the Uktulut tribe of tuskarr living in the Waking Shores. They are led by their Chieftain Tutaqan. The town was threatened by the djaradin, but it was protected by the adventurer sent by the Iskaara Tuskarr.

The Uktulut tribe is a tribe of tuskarr who have made their home in the Uktulut Backwater of the Waking Shores on the Dragon Isles. They are also present in the Uktulut Pier and Uktulut Outpost. They are formidable fighters, and are known for their deep connection with their ottuks.

The Uktulut Pier is a small harbor belonging to the Uktulut tribe of tuskarr living in the Waking Shores, accessed through the Crumbling Cliffs. The tribe used to trade with the Iskaara Tuskarr here until the djaradin began attacking their territory.
The Uktulut Outpost is a camp with a small harbor belonging to the Uktulut tribe of Tuskarr living in the Waking Shores. The Lost Arvillo travels between the outpost and Uktulut Pier.

Uldir sets are the appearance sets associated with patch 8.0.1 and Uldir, the first raid of Battle for Azeroth. They are visually themed after the raid and offer no set bonuses. There are a total of four Uldir appearance sets, one for each armor type. Despite not being proper tier sets, they are sometimes colloquially called Tier 22. Completing one of these sets will grant the New Mog, G'huun This? achievement.
Tyrannically Fortified is a affix for Mythic+ in WoW Remix: Legion. It shares the level 10 affix slot with Tyrannical (affix) and Fortified, cycling between the three each week.
